Overview

Nakhon Si Thammarat is a city in Nakhon Si Thammarat with a population of 120,000. An ancient southern city with a rich history, stunning temples, and one of the lowest costs of living in Thailand, ideal for those seeking authentic Thai culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
